name: Youth Tractor Safety Certification
city: Linn, Marion, Clackamas, Jefferson and other Oregon counties
what_you_do: Take a 22-hour course with online work, classroom time and tractor driving. It meets the Oregon Department of Agriculture rule for farm employers who hire minors.
who_can_apply: Youth ages 14 to 17 who want a summer farm or ranch job. You must attend every session of your class.
pay_detail: $75 in most counties and $95 in Clackamas County (2026 prices).
deadline_text: Classes run in spring and summer. The 2026 classes ran March to June 2026. Next dates not posted.
how_to_apply: Pick a county class on the page and use its register link. Or contact Andrea Leao or your local Extension office.
notes: The page says Oregon requires farmers and ranchers who hire minors under 18 to be sure those minors passed tractor safety training. That is the page's own statement. Ask your boss. 2026 sites included Linn, Marion, Clackamas and Jefferson counties.
